verdict.rationale: RustDesk documents running your own self-hosted servers, provides a compose file for the AGPL OSS server, and its GitHub states you can set up your own rendezvous/relay server. Hands-on users confirm years of use with their own relay server and working Docker deployments, though some report difficulty or poor performance. Missing for 10: authentication, web console and management features in the OSS self-hosted server (these are in Pro only), and consistent independent reports that self-hosting is easy and reliable.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product

citations.quote: a secure and reliable remote desktop experience with your own self-hosted servers
You can use our rendezvous/relay server, set up your own, or write your own rendezvous/relay server.
RustDesk provides an AGPL-licensed remote desktop client and OSS server
